# Career-Change Dashboard for Retail Manager → Data Analyst in Berlin

A clean dashboard concept can show **what transfers**, **what’s missing**, and **how to close the gap in 3 months**.
Assumption used here: the target is an entry-to-mid data analytics role in Berlin with a minimum compensation goal of **€52,000/year**.

## Skills Matrix and Gap View

**Legend:** Strong = ready to use now · Partial = some exposure · Gap = needs focused learning

| Skill Area | Current Level | Target Need | Gap Size | Dashboard Label |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Excel | Strong | Strong | Low | Transferable |
| Team leadership | Strong | Medium | Low | Transferable |
| Scheduling | Strong | Medium | Low | Transferable |
| Customer reporting | Strong | Strong | Low | Transferable |
| Basic SQL | Partial | Strong | Medium | Build |
| Python | None | Strong | High | Build |
| Tableau | None | Strong | High | Build |
| Statistics | None/Basic | Strong | High | Build |
| Stakeholder communication | Strong | Strong | Low | Transferable |

## Gap Analysis and 3-Month Learning Plan

### Visual concept
Use a three-part layout:
- **Left panel:** transferable skills highlighted in green
- **Center panel:** current vs target skill bars
- **Right panel:** missing skills ranked by urgency
- **Bottom strip:** 12-week learning roadmap with weekly milestones

### Gap chart logic
- **Low gap:** Excel, leadership, scheduling, customer reporting, stakeholder communication
- **Medium gap:** SQL
- **High gap:** Python, Tableau, statistics

### 3-month plan
| Month | Focus | Key Outcomes | Proof of Progress |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month 1 | SQL + analytics basics | Strengthen joins, aggregations, filtering, data cleaning | 2 SQL mini-projects |
| Month 2 | Python + statistics | Learn pandas, visualization, descriptive stats, hypothesis basics | 1 notebook + 1 analysis write-up |
| Month 3 | Tableau + portfolio | Build dashboards and present insights clearly | 2 portfolio dashboards + case study |

## Dashboard Layout Recommendation

### 1) Transferable Skills Card
Show a badge row for:
- Excel
- Team leadership
- Scheduling
- Customer reporting
- Stakeholder communication

### 2) Skills Matrix Heatmap
Use a 3-column matrix:
- **Current**
- **Target**
- **Priority gap**

Color suggestion:
- Green = transferable
- Amber = partial
- Red = missing

### 3) Gap-Analysis Chart
Best chart type:
- **Horizontal bar chart** with one bar per skill
- Bar length = gap size
- Sort from highest gap to lowest gap

Suggested ranking:
1. Python
2. Tableau
3. Statistics
4. SQL
5. Excel
6. Stakeholder communication
7. Team leadership
8. Scheduling
9. Customer reporting

### 4) Compensation Target Panel
Include a KPI tile:
- **Target salary:** €52,000/year minimum
- Optional note: “Benchmark against Berlin analytics roles and adjust by seniority, industry, and SQL/Python depth.”

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build Dashboard] https://www.figma.com/
Action: [Button: Track Skills] https://airtable.com/
Action: [Button: Berlin Jobs] https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
Action: [Button: Salary Check] https://www.glassdoor.de/

- Berlin salary and job benchmarking: https://www.glassdoor.de/
- Job market search for analytics roles in Berlin: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
- Portfolio/dashboard planning reference: https://www.figma.com/
- Skills tracking workflow: https://airtable.com/
